variant_decisions.evidence: Qere singular wayyomer against ketiv plural wayyomeru, with the plural subject 'the men of Israel'. ASV 'And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites' uses an English past tense that is identical for singular and plural agreement, and there is no ASV note on the verse, so the English cannot distinguish which form stood in the Hebrew. Both readings remain compatible; the qere base fallback carries the projection.

Qere defective ekhrat against ketiv plene ekhrot: the same verb and form, differing only in the writing of the holem vowel, so the two readings render identically. ASV 'how shall we make a covenant with you?' and the absence of any ASV note leave nothing that could distinguish an orthographic variant. Both readings remain compatible; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
